newsitem.title: MEXICO: Santander Mexicano completes $425 mln restructure.
newsitem.headline: Santander Mexicano completes $425 mln restructure.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Santander Mexicano said on Tuesday it had finished recapitalizing its newly-acquired Mexican bank unit with $425 million and also announced a first quarter net loss of 110 million pesos.
"We have finished the process of capitalization...100 percent of the increase was covered by shareholders," the group's president, Carlos Gomez y Gomez, told reporters.
Santander Mexicano is a unit of Spanish financial group Banco Santander.
The group's capitalization ratio after the restructuring was 13.88 percent, he said at a news conference in Mexico City.
Santander in Spain holds a 51 percent controlling stake in the group and Mexican shareholders own 49 percent.
